svg.title: Kenedy, a developer
svg.desc: A neon sign reading KENEDY in double-line capitals, magenta outer tubes with cyan tubes running inside them, with a developer in cyan below, hangs on a graffiti-covered concrete wall at night. Sprayed on the wall: black screen, linux terminal, an AI to argue with. A wanted poster pasted on the wall reads: Wanted for pair programming with AI, choosing the approach, testing and reviewing, round after round, until the problem is solved. Stenciled on the wall: Computer Engineering student.
